brief: 3 in-game frames (Tidewake) for one catalogue subject: Veilfall approach shallows. Judge that subject as the game's real look - identity and read at a glance, silhouette, palette, lighting and fit with the key art and its chapter board.
defects: A ruler-straight chain of nearly identical tan discs with white rims makes the Veilfall approach read as mechanical stepping stones rather than natural current shallows
